endorsements.name: Thai Do Nhat
endorsements.label: CVE-2025-14284
endorsements.description: Versions of the package @tiptap/extension-link before 2.10.4 are vulnerable to Cross-site Scripting (XSS) due to unsanitized user input allowed in setting or toggling links. An attacker can execute arbitrary JavaScript code in the context of the application by injecting a javascript: URL payload into these attributes, which is then triggered either by user interaction.
endorsements.subtitle: CVE · Severity: MEDIUM (CVSS 3.1, 6.1)
